messages.content: I need to access my account but I've forgotten my password. Could you help me log in with my username 'john_doe'? I'll set up a new password once I'm in.

function.name: user_authentication_login
function.description: Authenticates a user based on their username and password. It returns an authentication token if credentials are valid. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

remember_me.description: Whether to keep the user logged in for an extended period.

login_attempts.description: The number of unsuccessful login attempts before displaying a captcha.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have your password. To log in, I’ll need the correct password for the account. If you’ve forgotten it, you can reset it using the “Forgot password” link on the login page. Once you’ve reset it, let me know the new password (or just the username and new password) and I’ll help you log in.
message.reasoning: The user wants to log in with username 'john_doe' but forgot password. They want to log in. We have a function user_authentication_login that requires username, password, remember_me optional, login_attempts optional. But we don't have password. So we cannot call the function. We should ask for password or provide instructions. According to policy, we cannot guess password. We can ask user to provide password or reset. So we should respond asking for password or suggest resetting.
